brainlife.desc: Unstructured output folder for development or App-specific results (QA images, MNE or cortexmap derivatives); no fixed files.
brainlife.name: raw

original.desc: Unstructured data not meant to be used as input to any other Apps. You can use this datatype for development purposes. Please register a new datatype once your App is ready to be used by other users.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Development outputs and App-specific results not meant as a shared contract.

**Not for:** Input to general Apps; content depends on the producing App and its tags. Sharing without checking what the folder holds.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 11 Apps, output of 146 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/raw.json

identifying_risks: Content is unknown and may include identifiable images
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 5 (unknown): provisional Tier 3 until the content is assessed.
tier_conditions: Tier 2 or lower once the content is reviewed
